turn_on_activation_checkpointing_single_: turn on activation checkpointing for a single named submodule of a PyTorch model to save memory
turn_on_activation_checkpointing_multipl: turn on activation checkpointing for multiple named submodules of a PyTorch model by passing a list of names
wrap_forward_checkpoint: wrap a forward function with PyTorch checkpoint to recompute activations during backpropagation instead of caching them
review_wrap_forward: review the wrap_forward function that wraps a forward pass with torch.utils.checkpoint for memory-efficient training
summarize_activation_checkpointing: summarize the activation checkpointing utility that reduces GPU memory by recomputing activations on the backward pass
